gen-gf-kavivanar-archivo: Kavivanar's lowercase s flares open at both ends, giving the heading a loose, hand-drawn lilt. And Archivo takes over with a tall x-height and outward-opening curves, giving the page an editorial footing under all that friendly wobble.
gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-asap: Loose, handwritten, and friendly right away. Kavivanar draws every glyph with one line thickness, and Asap, the sturdier sans, keeps its lowercase low and its c forms open for readable text.
gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-bespoke-serif: Relaxed handwriting leads here, drawn as if with a round-tipped pen. Then Bespoke Serif follows in a text serif voice, its thin strokes about half the weight of its thick ones, which lends the page a dignified tone.
gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads as approachable and contemporary, with curvy, wire-thin letters and a tall lowercase that stops at stubby ascender tips. Next to Kavivanar's moderate height, long text feels light and easy.
gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-erode: Hand-lettered charm meets a dignified, bookish voice. Kavivanar is best at warm, uniform strokes that feel written by hand, while Erode, a classic serif, does its best work with a tall middle band and gently shifting stroke weight.
gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-fira-sans: Kavivanar leads with a hand-drawn stroke and a lowercase s that flares open at its ends. But Fira Sans, a plain sans with a large x-height and no thick-thin contrast, steadies everything underneath.
gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-public-sans: Not one hairline appears anywhere in Kavivanar, whose handwritten strokes stay friendly and relaxed throughout. And Public Sans, a hefty sans-serif with broad counters on c and s, makes a long passage feel sturdy and trustworthy.
gen-gf-kavivanar-fs-supreme: Handwritten, easygoing, one flat line weight throughout. Supreme, a crisp sans with a thick, heavy strip of text through the middle, gives Kavivanar's looser heading a firm, open-shaped partner.
gen-gf-kavivanar-general-sans: Kavivanar looks hand-drawn and friendly, its s flaring open at both ends, with every stroke held at one steady line. General Sans fills the line with a big x-height and smooth curves.
gen-gf-kavivanar-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Handwritten warmth meets a bookish, weighty voice. BhuTuka Expanded One, a text serif with curvy letters and a leisurely reading pace, is the pair's authoritative, literary anchor beneath Kavivanar's relaxed hand.
